titulo: The plant back up after Tuesday
caption:
The plant back up after Tuesday

The plant had been on its side since Tuesday. Back up, it looked like it had never fallen.

A fallen pot loses its soil a little more each day, and standing it up takes one second.

For whoever stands the fallen pot back up right away.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table and a green plant in a terracotta pot lying on its side at the right. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes trembles at the left, then its eyes go wide, it steps closer and the pot swings upright and settles. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me: I'll fix it later, to: stood it up. nothing spilled.
